CODE-ANAL.description: Steel Code Check Analysis (CODE-ANAL) for AIJ-ASD02. Runs the steel design code check over a set of targets selected by PERFORM_TYPE; the request body is wrapped in Argument. Prerequisites: analysis results must exist (errors with 'Please perform analysis.' otherwise) and the steel design code must be set to AIJ-ASD02 first via PUT /TEMP/DESIGN/STEEL/AIJ-ASD02/DCO. Runs SYNCHRONOUSLY in the MIDAS instance: failure is reported in-band (HTTP 200 with an error/SUCCESS=false body, e.g. a 'failed:' message), and a large model can exceed the ~60s client read timeout, which stalls subsequent requests. Response is a single message string. Run this before querying CODE-TABLE / CODE-REPORT / DREULT.

Argument.description: Steel code check request. Fields drive which elements/sections are checked based on PERFORM_TYPE.

PERFORM_TYPE.description: Perform Target - All Elements: ALL / By Element No.: ELEMS / By Section No.: SECTIONS. Case-insensitive. Calling POST without a body checks ALL elements.
